question: Which of the following is not a kind of Parliamentary Question?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Long Notice Question**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Parliamentary Proceedings

 
 
• The first hour of every parliamentary sitting is for ''The Question hour''.
 
• The members ask questions and the ministers usually give answers during this time.
 
 
 
• The questions are of three kinds:
 
 
• Starred question: It requires an oral answer and hence any supplementary questions can follow.
 
• Unstarred question: It requires a written answer, for this reason, supplementary questions cannot follow.
 
• Short notice question: It is a type of question that is asked by giving a notice of fewer than ten days. It is answered orally, not requiring any written answer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The Parliament has two Houses–Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha. Rajya Sabha is the upper House and represents the States of India while the Lok Sabha is the lower House. The President is an integral part of the Parliament though he is not a member of either House.
 
• Indian Parliament was created after 1947.
 
• The Indian Parliament is an expression of the faith that the people of India have in the principles of democracy.
 
• The Parliament in our system has immense powers because it is the representative of the people.
 
• Elections to the Parliament are held in a similar manner as they are for the state legislature.
 
• The Lok Sabha is usually elected once every five years.
 
• The country is divided into numerous constituencies.
 
• Each of these constituencies elects one person to the Parliament.
 
• The candidates who contest elections usually belong to different political parties.
 
• The Parliament which is made up of all representatives together, controls and guides the government.
